# Uploaded as .htaccess (Apache / LiteSpeed, e.g. Hostinger).
# Generated by build.py from src/static-templates/htaccess.txt

AddDefaultCharset UTF-8
DirectoryIndex index.html
ErrorDocument 404 /404.html

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On

  # Always use https
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off
  RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

  # Always use www (the address Google knows). Remove the # on the next 2 lines
  # only after checking that https://www.markopoulos-oliveoil.gr works.
  # RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^markopoulos-oliveoil\.gr$ [NC]
  # RewriteRule ^ https://www.markopoulos-oliveoil.gr%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

  # Addresses of the old Hostinger Builder site -> new pages (keeps Google links working)
  RewriteRule ^oi-yphresies-mas/?$        /ypiresies.html     [L,R=301]
  RewriteRule ^to-3ekinhma-mas/?$         /istoria.html       [L,R=301]
  RewriteRule ^h-epixeirhsh-mas/?$        /egkatastaseis.html [L,R=301]
  RewriteRule ^epikoinwnhste-mazi-mas/?$  /epikoinonia.html   [L,R=301]
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
  Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
  Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
  Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
  Header always set Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_expires.c>
  ExpiresActive On
  ExpiresByType text/html "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType text/css "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/javascript "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType image/jpeg "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType image/webp "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType image/png "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType image/x-icon "access plus 6 months"
  ExpiresByType font/woff2 "access plus 1 year"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css application/javascript image/svg+xml application/xml text/plain
</IfModule>

# Fonts need the right type for some browsers
AddType font/woff2 .woff2
